declarations.docstring: An auxiliary type-valued construction depending on a commutative ring, another type, and a module over the ring.
The action of an element of the opposite ring on a linear dual evaluates by applying the functional after the corresponding action on the vector.
The module structure of the linear dual over the opposite ring induced by a compatible action on the original module.
The scalar action of the opposite ring on the linear dual induced by precomposition with the action on the original module.
